title: Rebuilt
did: The song’s own beats cut up and rearranged into a new 60-second loop: quiet music box, heavy part, quiet, heavy, and a middle stretch that leads back to the start. Cuts are only made where both sides match, and every piece is set to one steady speed.
feel: Sounds like Carnival of Ashes, but a new order of its parts that loops forever with no ending or fade.

title: Rebuilt, dark
did: The same rebuilt loop through the dark mix: 12% slower, two half-steps lower, softer highs, a faint wobble and a room.
feel: Darker and heavier, still with a steady beat.
use: Every fight, or only the bosses.

title: Fractured lullaby
did: Built from fragments: the quietest music-box bars smeared into a floating chord, its little tunes slowed and echoing (some backwards, as swells), a slow heartbeat made from its own kick drum, and its heaviest hits far off like thunder.
feel: Ethereal and ominous: no carnival left, only its ghost. Slow, with a heartbeat for a pulse.
use: Wraiths, the final boss, or as the danger-zone music.
